server_tcp_port.description: The TCP port udptunnel will listen on in server mode.

udp_address.description: The IPv4 address or hostname of the UDP service to tunnel.

udp_port.description: The UDP port on the target host to send tunneled packets to.

ttl.description: Time To Live for multicast UDP packets. Set to 0 for unicast.

rtp_mode.description: Enable RTP mode to tunnel RTP/RTCP traffic on consecutive ports.

verbose.description: Enable verbose output for debugging connection establishment.
